title: Fix W6 P0 customer-visible product gaps before customer review
objective: Implement the repo-owned W6 P0 fixes from HR-17. Do not stop at analysis. Patch the product behavior, keep UX aligned to the existing production-facing UI, add focused regression tests, commit, push dev, and write a completion report.

allowed_scope: Export per-document selection, Select All, selected count/total, selected-only preview/download
Review Scan seller/buyer party fields and line-item approve/reject/unconfirm controls
Approve All behavior for confirmable line items
Companies master-data table consistency for COA, AP Vendor Master, AR Customer Master, and Product Master
Template Configurator mode wiring or honest disabled state, plus manual config fallback
Upload company Tax ID match/warning if feasible in the current UI/API shape
Excel-safe date export behavior or an explicit default XLSX/customer-safe path
Focused API/unit/e2e regression tests that reproduce HR-17 symptoms
forbidden_scope: Do not redesign the product shell
Do not replace the frozen full-page export flow with a modal-first picker
Do not leave fake-click controls visible on customer-facing surfaces
Do not weaken auth/RBAC to make tests pass
Do not add deploy workflows to this repo

work_items.title: Export document selection
work_items.required_outcome: Each export row has a checkbox, Select All/Clear works, preview/download receives selected document_ids, and selected-only output is covered by tests.

work_items.title: Review Scan party fields and line-item decisions
work_items.required_outcome: Seller name, seller tax ID, buyer name, and buyer tax ID are visible/editable. Line items can be confirmed/rejected/unconfirmed. Approve All includes line items or asks clearly.

work_items.title: Companies master-data tab consistency
work_items.required_outcome: COA, AP Vendor Master, AR Customer Master, and Product Master share search, count, load more/page, import/add, edit, and delete/deactivate behavior where backend permits.

work_items.title: Template Configurator mode/manual fallback
work_items.required_outcome: Flat Document, Flatten Row, and Grouped Summary are wired or visibly disabled with precise labels. Manual column setup is reachable and aligned with UX freeze.

work_items.title: Upload company match, Excel date proof path, and test quality
work_items.required_outcome: Restore or clearly warn on company Tax ID match, provide Excel-safe export behavior, and add tests that fail on the observed human issue before passing.

acceptance: All touched UI keeps visual/layout alignment with main-ux-ui.html and index.html parity.
No W6 P0 visible control is UI-only.
Tests include at least one regression that proves a human-found issue would have been caught.
Completion report names changed files, tests run, residual risk, and any explicit deferrals.
